name: plakar-standards
description: PlakarKorp engineering conventions: session-injected rules, gofmt/vet/lint feedback on every write, guards on generated and vendored trees.

strict_lint.title: Report golangci-lint findings
strict_lint.description: Run golangci-lint on edited files and report findings back to Claude. Turn off if your machine's linter is slow or noisy.

inject_rules.title: Inject conventions at session start
inject_rules.description: Load the PlakarKorp rule set into context at the start of every session.
